entries.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished independent PROMPT DEPT. adult one-piece hooded zip lounge-suit concept. Portrait 4:5, full garment from hood to footless ankles in frame, neatly flat laid on pale warm grey studio background, subtle believable shadows. Adult relaxed proportions, sleeves and legs connected into ONE garment, ordinary black central front zipper, no ears, no rear opening, no strings or novel fasteners. Matte midweight soft jersey/fleece cloth, self-fabric wrist hems and softly gathered self-fabric ankles, discreet side-seam pocket openings only, no exterior pouch pockets. All art is flat print, never raised embroidery or sewn patches. A design mockup, not an official collaboration. Show BACK VIEW of only one full garment. Art direction: Black with rusty orange and cream racing-club graphics; large Clawd pixel mascot framed by a single broken progress ring, sleeve stripe.
Exact main lettering, slash means line break: "I DON'T CHEAT. / I WAIT FOR CLAUDE / TO RESET.". No extra readable text except model branding explicitly specified in art direction and small PROMPT DEPT. Make all lettering perfectly spelled. For front view keep all main wording on a SINGLE chest panel entirely clear of zipper and pocket openings. Front designs are compact, calm and wearable. Back designs have strong 2-second hierarchy with lettering below the lowered hood, clear of side seams. All model names and emblems represent an independent fan concept, never an official collaboration. When Clawd is specified use recognizable orange rectangular pixel mascot with two black rectangular eyes and block feet, not a realistic crab. When OpenAI blossom is specified use recognizable white or black six-loop interwoven knot mark without adding a face. Any stripes, symbols and label-like shapes are printed, never raised patches or functional hardware. Don't invent brand partnership wording. No child proportions, feet, model/person, multiple garments, cropped hood or hems, external captions, watermark, shiny satin, or busy allover wallpaper.
